entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The final product of Urza's Bloodline Project and captain of the Weatherlight, a reluctant hero who dies stopping Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who bred the Bloodline Project and built the Legacy; later decapitated by Gerrard in Phyrexia and surviving as a head.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: A Jamuraan warlord and ally of Urza who adopted Gerrard; father of Vuel.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Gerrard's adoptive brother Vuel, transformed into a shapeshifting Phyrexian evincar of Rath and Gerrard's greatest enemy.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: A human native of Rath sent to infiltrate Kondo's tribe who later joins the Weatherlight crew because the Phyrexians hold his daughter.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem, part of the Legacy and Gerrard's guardian, who later becomes a planeswalker.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: An ally of Urza under whom Gerrard trained.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: An elf friend of Gerrard killed in the assault on Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat-warrior who loves Gerrard and dies at Crovax's hands.

entities.name: Keilic
entities.description: A cat-warrior who fell in love with Mirri and opposed Gerrard in a ritual.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight and part of the Bloodline Project, Gerrard's mentor.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: The Weatherlight's navigator and Gerrard's love, who dies of a Phyrexian plague.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who becomes a vampire and later the evincar of Rath; killed by Gerrard.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur, Sisay's right hand, wielding the axe that becomes the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard left on Rath who becomes a Phyrexian minion.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elvish lord of the Skyshroud who frees Mirri and Hanna and later warns Llanowar.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: A prophetess who tells Gerrard he is the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A Rathi who cuts Gerrard's face in the battle over Rath.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A fallen angel, Crovax's love, under Volrath's thrall; killed by Crovax.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: Starke's daughter, held prisoner by the Phyrexians, who blinds her father while mind-controlled.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A healer of the Weatherlight who learned about the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: The leading general of the Invasion who manipulated Gerrard's grief.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The ruler of the Phyrexians who killed Sisay's parents and invades Dominaria as a Black Cloud of Death.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin member of the Weatherlight crew, captured by Ertai.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: She recruits House Capashen for the reassembled Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A flying ship that is part of the Legacy and captained by Sisay and Gerrard.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: Artifacts and beings gathered by Urza against Yawgmoth; completed as the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Urza's secret program breeding a perfect human to stand against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane of the Stronghold and Volrath's seat of power.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane where the Weatherlight crashes and the crew aids a rebellion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The home plane invaded by Phyrexia.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: Rath's seat of power, home to the Dream Halls.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: Mercadian rebels who believed the Weatherlight was a sign of their god Ramos.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: A relic held by the Saprazzan merfolk, used to upgrade the Weatherlight's engines.

events.summary: Gerrard's family is murdered by Phyrexian raiders, and Karn takes the boy to Sidar Kondo, who adopts him.
events.quote: took the little boy to an ally of Urza, the Jamuraan warlord Sidar Kondo , who adopted the boy

events.summary: Starke poisons the ritual paint, causing Vuel to fail his initiation.
events.quote: Starke poisoned the paint with which ritual tattoos were placed on his body

events.summary: Vuel steals Gerrard's Legacy items and disables Karn to finance an army against his tribe, leading to his father's death.
events.quote: Vuel stole the Legacy items Gerrard possessed and disabled Karn, selling these items to finance an army

events.summary: Gerrard trains under Multani and befriends Rofellos and Mirri.
events.quote: Here he befriended the elf Rofellos and the cat -warrior Mirri .

events.summary: Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri join Sisay's Weatherlight crew after Gerrard loses a wager.
events.quote: with Gerrard having lost a tavern wager over a contest of knife-throwing against her

events.summary: Gerrard falls in love with navigator Hanna.
events.quote: Gerrard fell in love with the ship's navigator, Hanna

events.summary: Phyrexians attack Crovax's Estate hunting Bloodline subjects; Rofellos is killed and Gerrard quits the Weatherlight.
events.quote: During this battle, Rofellos was killed, which was too much for Gerrard.

events.summary: Gerrard learns Starke betrayed the Phyrexians and had been feeding Sisay information about the Legacy.
events.quote: it was none other than Starke who had betrayed his masters and had supplied Sisay with information about the Legacy

events.summary: Gerrard reanimates the frozen Karn using his instinctive knowledge of artifice as heir to the Legacy.
events.quote: Gerrard managed to reanimate him with the instinctive knowledge of artifice he had as heir to the Legacy

events.summary: Gerrard is scarred by Greven il-Vec, falls into the Skyshroud, and learns from Oracle en-Vec that he is the Korvecdal.
events.quote: There he discovered the prophetess Oracle en -Vec who told him he was the Korvecdal

events.summary: Eladamri, who had imprisoned Mirri and Hanna, releases them after Gerrard explains.
events.quote: He was brought to the home of the elvish lord Eladamri

events.summary: Crovax kills Selenia, which triggers a curse that turns him into a vampire.
events.quote: Crovax killed her, but this triggered a curse on him and turned him into a vampire .

events.summary: In the Dream Halls Gerrard realizes Volrath is his adoptive brother Vuel.
events.quote: Gerrard suddenly had flashbacks to his youth and the actions of Vuel, and realized the truth: Volrath was Vuel!

events.summary: Gerrard stabs his brother, but later learns he killed only a shapeshifter scapegoat.
events.quote: Volrath had used a scapegoat and that he had just killed another shapeshifter

events.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after going insane and leaving the ship.
events.quote: Mirri had followed him, which had led to her death at his hands.

events.summary: Takara betrays the group, steals the Bones of Ramos, and reveals she is Volrath.
events.quote: revealed her true identity: Volrath.

events.summary: The Magistrate is deposed by the people of Mercadia and the Weatherlight returns to Dominaria.
events.quote: The Magistrate was deposed by the rebelling people of Mercadia

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria begins as the crew returns home.
events.quote: the Phyrexian Invasion began

events.summary: Hanna dies of the Phyrexian plague at Koilos.
events.quote: shortly after their arrival, Hanna died.

events.summary: Tsabo Tavoc manipulates Gerrard's grief to control his mind until his friends and Karn free him.
events.quote: Tsabo Tavoc , manipulated Gerrard's grief over Hanna to gain control over his mind

events.summary: Gerrard and Squee are captured by Ertai, now a Phyrexian minion.
events.quote: Gerrard and Squee were captured by a new minion of the Phyrexians: Ertai

events.summary: Crovax, now evincar, takes Gerrard to Phyrexia where Gerrard pledges loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.
events.quote: where he pledged his loyalty to Yawgmoth, who promised he could bring Hanna back from the dead.

events.summary: Gerrard decapitates the powerless Urza in a fight set by Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Robbed of his powers as a planeswalker within the Ninth Sphere, Urza could not best the skill of Gerrard and was decapitated.

events.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax in the Stronghold's throne room.
events.quote: Gerrard confronted and killed Crovax

events.summary: Yawgmoth enters Dominaria as a gigantic Black Cloud of Death.
events.quote: Yawgmoth himself entered Dominaria in the form of a gigantic Black Cloud of Death

events.summary: Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy Weapon.
events.quote: asked Gerrard to take out his powerstone eyes and place them in two sockets in Karn's chest

events.summary: Gerrard, Urza, Karn and the Legacy disappear and the Weatherlight sinks off Urborg.
events.quote: Then Gerrard, Urza, Karn, and the Legacy disappeared, and Weatherlight sank off of Urborg.

events.summary: Karn returns as a planeswalker containing Gerrard and Urza.
events.quote: He had transcended into a planeswalker, thanks to the essence of the Thran artificer Glacian that had survived within Urza's powerstone eyes
